#060 · Tadpole Pokémon

Poliwag

Water

Kanto · Generation 1

Poliwag is a Water-type Tadpole Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 12.4 kg. It evolves into Poliwhirl. Its highest base stat is Speed (90), with a base stat total of 300.
